# Formation Planet Ltd

> Global business formation, compliance and banking. We help founders register UK Ltd and USA LLC companies in 24 hours and stay compliant with banking, tax and annual filings.

## UK Services

- [UK Services](/uk-services): All UK Ltd formation and compliance services.
- [UK Ltd Formation](/uk-ltd-formation): Register a UK Limited company in 24 hours.
- [UK Compliance](/uk-compliance): Annual filing, returns and statutory updates.
- [LTD ID Verification](/ltd-id-verification): Mandatory PSC and director verification.
- [Registered Office Address](/registered-office-address): Prestigious London business address.
- [UK VAT Registration](/uk-vat-registration): HMRC VAT registration for UK Ltd companies.
- [UTR Number](/utr-number): Apply for a UK Unique Taxpayer Reference.
- [Annual Accounts](/annual-accounts): Year-end statutory accounts filing.
- [Company Annual Filing](/company-annual-filing): Confirmation statements and updates.
- [Authentication Code](/auth-code): Companies House authentication code service.
- [Activation Code](/activation-code): HMRC online services activation.
- [Director Change](/director-change): Add or remove company directors.
- [Company Name Change](/company-name-change): Change registered company name.
- [Address Change](/address-change): Update registered office or director address.
- [PSC & Secretary Update](/psc-secretary-update): Update PSCs and secretaries.
- [AD01 Postal Filing](/ad01-postal-filing): Sensitive postal AD01 filings.
